definitions.gloss: made of metal; metal- (as a material modifier)
definitions.explanation: Indicating that an object is made of metal. Used to specify material, often in contrast to {木製|もくせい} (wooden) or {プラスチック製|プラスチックせい} (plastic).

examples.japanese: {金属製|きんぞくせい}のスプーン。
{金属製|きんぞくせい}の{容器|ようき}は{丈夫|じょうぶ}で{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Metal containers are sturdy and last a long time.

examples.japanese: {機内|きない}には{金属製|きんぞくせい}の{刃物|はもの}を{持|も}ち{込|こ}むことができない。
examples.english: You cannot bring metal blades into the airplane cabin.

notes:
Compound of {金属|きんぞく} (metal) + the suffix {製|せい} (made of). The {製|せい} suffix is highly productive after material names: {木製|もくせい} (wooden), {ガラス製|ガラスせい} (made of glass), {布製|ぬのせい} (made of cloth).

GRAMMAR:
- As a noun modifier: {金属製|きんぞくせい}の + noun ({金属製|きんぞくせい}の{箱|はこ})
- As a predicate: {金属製|きんぞくせい}だ / です

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金属製|きんぞくせい}の{家具|かぐ}: metal furniture
- {金属製|きんぞくせい}の{部品|ぶひん}: metal parts
- {金属製|きんぞくせい}のフレーム: metal frame
